title: octopus-favicon-pack v1
description: A brand pack: the favicon/icon assets for one app slug, from either a cheap emoji SVG (octopus-kit) or a designed sharp-rendered set (octopus-studio). pack.js is the executable form of this schema and adds the cross-field rules a schema cannot (sha256/bytes actually matching data, declared type matching role, at most one file per role, the favicon role required). The directory form used for a zip download carries the same object as pack.json, minus each file's `data` (the bytes are the sibling file at `path` instead).

slug.description: The app's hub-apps.json slug. Never invented — it is what the pack is assigned to.

value.description: The emoji, or the sanitised SVG markup. Omitted or producer-defined for kind "raster".

files.description: At most one file per role (validate.js enforces this; a schema cannot). The "favicon" role is the only required one.

type.description: MIME type. Must equal the role's fixed type (image/svg+xml for favicon, image/png for the raster roles, image/x-icon for ico).

bytes.description: Must equal the decoded length of `data`.

sha256.description: Of the decoded bytes of `data`. What packId is computed from, together with role/path/slug/version.

data.description: The file content, as `encoding` says. Absent in the directory form's pack.json — the bytes are the sibling file at `path` instead.
